# Rigorous causal GSEWS synthetic benchmark

This benchmark uses equal isotropic node noise, a graph-commuting drift
operator, trailing-only processing, and window-end eligibility.

## Locked configuration

```json
{
  "seed": 20260804,
  "n_nodes": 48,
  "n_steps": 1800,
  "dt": 0.05,
  "transition_step": 1440,
  "ramp_start": 660,
  "baseline_end": 620,
  "prediction_window": 300,
  "prediction_horizons": [
    160,
    360,
    560
  ],
  "window": 160,
  "stride": 20,
  "trailing_smooth": 3,
  "trend_span": 8,
  "noise_sigma": 0.2,
  "spectral_center": 0.35,
  "cubic_strength": 1.0,
  "heterogeneity": 0.0,
  "graph_perturbation": 0.2,
  "n_seeds_per_graph": 20,
  "bootstrap_replicates": 2000,
  "graphs": [
    "ring",
    "small_world",
    "modular",
    "scale_free"
  ],
  "models": [
    "graph_commuting_ou",
    "graph_pattern_normal_form"
  ],
  "output_dir": "results/rigorous_pilot"
}
```
